name: Fallback stress test
task: Compare two hypothetical builds under three conditions: engine available, engine absent and engine removed. Track which actions remain viable; do not invent card effects.

name: Payoff access audit
task: For a random 39-card population compare nine and eleven payoff slots with nine and ten distinct observations. Then identify what would change under a conditional mulligan.

name: Threshold allocation
task: In an abstract two-turn budget compare an immediate threat that consumes future capacity with a weaker threat preserving future capacity. Add an imminent opposing win as a counterexample.

name: Scoring cycle review
task: Compare an exposed contest and protected development through both players' next decisions, recording score and remaining threats; no assumed opposing action.

name: Threat density and hit composition
task: With a random order of eight eligible units and three preferred hits, compute baseline conditional hit fraction; remove known cards and recompute only under explicit order assumptions.

name: Sideboard and fallback
task: A practice pair reduces a threat slot for an answer; inspect access, role and replacement legality before testing.

name: Information timing
task: Construct two plausible opposing hands and compare proactive disruption now versus at the decisive turn, without using actual unpublished cards.

name: Historical translation
task: Choose one banned-engine strategic function and design an abstract legal replacement role; identify exact rules evidence needed before any named-card narration.
